root_cause: The mandatory Windows CI provisioner started PostgreSQL 17 without installing pgvector, so the P11-004 migration could pass locally while failing on a clean hosted runner.
impact_surface: all clean CI runs that migrate through p11_004_pgvector_fts
repair: Build pgvector 0.8.1 from the immutable upstream commit using the runner's x64 Visual Studio toolchain only when absent, verify the exact source commit and installed extension version, pre-create vector and btree_gin in the isolated test database, and emit a bounded provenance receipt.
rollback: Revert this repair commit; the workflow returns to its prior PostgreSQL-only provisioner and no production state is affected.

verification.local_source_build_branch: not exercised because the exact binary was already installed; a later diagnostic source fetch failed with a GitHub 443 timeout and was not rerun without new information
